question: At exactly lambda=0, can the raw-C recessive solution be transported from the plus end to Q0=-4 by its exact modified-Bessel representation, with outward-rounded ball certificates for the five previously observed sign-changing characteristic brackets?

upstream_results.role: pins the declared weighted raw-C fiber, endpoint classification and lambda-zero modified-Bessel reduction
provides the five coarse sign-change brackets to re-evaluate with rigorous ball arithmetic
pins the Qplus=4 normalized log-derivative error budget used as an independent containment check

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, modified Bessel equation, standard K solution, Wronskian and derivative recurrences, sections 10.25, 10.28 and 10.29
primary_sources.used_for: the exact lambda-zero Bessel reduction, recessive K branch, Wronskian and derivative formulas
primary_sources.not_used_for: ball-arithmetic implementation correctness, nonzero-lambda transport, F_lambda, a spectral measure or RAQ

primary_sources.source: Fredrik Johansson, Arb: Efficient Arbitrary-Precision Midpoint-Radius Interval Arithmetic
primary_sources.used_for: midpoint-radius ball inclusion semantics and outward-rounded special-function evaluation
primary_sources.not_used_for: a validated ODE theorem or any raw-C operator conclusion

primary_sources.used_for: locked access to FLINT/Arb complex-order Bessel I and K balls
primary_sources.not_used_for: claiming that an arbitrary floating-point computation is rigorous without explicit sign, containment and nesting checks

declared_conventions.root_input: the five upstream initial sign-change brackets, not the nonrigorous refined centers
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy change-of-variable identities plus python-flint/Arb balls; no ODE solve, finite difference, quadrature or parameter sampling grid

assumptions: All numerical enclosures are conditional on python-flint 0.9.0 and its bundled FLINT/Arb implementation; the lock file and runtime version are recorded.
A sign-changing bracket proves at least one real characteristic zero by continuity. It does not by itself prove uniqueness or exclude even-multiplicity or additional sub-bracket zeros.

The exact Bessel representation transports the lambda-zero recessive solution direction without forming an ill-conditioned fundamental matrix. The ball checks cover the declared endpoint quantities and bracket bands, not every kappa in [0,8].
The Qplus Liouville-Green comparison checks only containment by the already proved lambda-zero tail budget. It is not reused as a differentiated lambda-tail theorem.
No lambda derivative is evaluated. Endpoint F_lambda, nonzero-lambda validated transport, nonreal Weyl m data, spectral measure, rigging map and C-to-H quantum equivalence remain null.
tasks: verify every upstream file hash, payload hash, verdict and VALID_RUN state
verify exactly the Q-to-x change of variables, the imaginary-order Bessel equation, p parity and the first-order lambda sensitivity forcing that remains open
re-evaluate both ends of every upstream coarse root bracket with complex-order Bessel balls and require certified opposite real signs
bisect each bracket at 80 and 120 decimal digits, require every selected sign to exclude zero, and require the higher-precision bracket to nest inside the lower-precision bracket
on each high-precision bracket band, prove K_(i*kappa)(x0) excludes zero and the Q-Wronskian ball contains one
at Qplus=4, use scaled K values to avoid underflow and require the exact Bessel log derivative to lie inside the inherited Liouville-Green normalized error budget
write endpoint F_lambda, nonzero-lambda transport, spectral, RAQ, BFV, physical and TOE outputs as explicit nulls
